verses.original: בִּלְעָם֙ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֶל־ בָּלָ֔ק בְּנֵה־ לִ֥י שִׁבְעָ֣ה מִזְבְּחֹ֑ת בָזֶ֖ה וְהָכֵ֥ן לִי֙ בָּזֶ֔ה שִׁבְעָ֥ה פָרִ֖ים וְשִׁבְעָ֥ה אֵילִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: bil·‘ām way·yō·mer ’el- bā·lāq bə·nêh- lî šiḇ·‘āh miz·bə·ḥōṯ ḇā·zeh wə·hā·ḵên lî bā·zeh šiḇ·‘āh p̄ā·rîm wə·šiḇ·‘āh ’ê·lîm
verses.literal: Then Balaam said to Balak Build for me seven altars here and prepare for me . . . seven bulls and seven rams

verses.original: בָּלָ֔ק וַיַּ֣עַשׂ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר בִּלְעָ֑ם דִּבֶּ֣ר בָּלָ֧ק וּבִלְעָ֛ם וַיַּ֨עַל פָּ֥ר וָאַ֖יִל בַּמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: bā·lāq way·ya·‘aś ka·’ă·šer bil·‘ām dib·ber bā·lāq ū·ḇil·‘ām way·ya·‘al pār wā·’a·yil bam·miz·bê·aḥ
verses.literal: So Balak did as Balaam had instructed and Balak and Balaam offered a bull and a ram on each altar

verses.original: הִתְיַצֵּב֮ עַל־ עֹלָתֶךָ֒ וְאֵֽלְכָ֗ה בִּלְעָ֜ם וַיֹּ֨אמֶר לְבָלָ֗ק אוּלַ֞י יִקָּרֵ֤ה יְהוָה֙ לִקְרָאתִ֔י וּדְבַ֥ר מַה־ יַּרְאֵ֖נִי וְהִגַּ֣דְתִּי לָ֑ךְ וַיֵּ֖לֶךְ שֶֽׁפִי׃
verses.transliteration: hiṯ·yaṣ·ṣêḇ ‘al- ‘ō·lā·ṯe·ḵā wə·’ê·lə·ḵāh bil·‘ām way·yō·mer lə·ḇā·lāq ’ū·lay yiq·qā·rêh Yah·weh liq·rā·ṯî ū·ḏə·ḇar mah- yar·’ê·nî wə·hig·gaḏ·tî lāḵ way·yê·leḵ še·p̄î
verses.literal: Stay here by your burnt offering while I am gone Balaam said to Balak Perhaps . . . the LORD will meet with me . . . And whatever He reveals to me I will tell you So [Balaam] went off to a barren height

verses.original: אֱלֹהִ֖ים וַיִּקָּ֥ר אֶל־ בִּלְעָ֑ם עָרַ֔כְתִּי שִׁבְעַ֤ת הַֽמִּזְבְּחֹת֙ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֗יו אֶת־ בַּמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃ וָאַ֛עַל פָּ֥ר וָאַ֖יִל
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·lō·hîm way·yiq·qār ’el- bil·‘ām ‘ā·raḵ·tî šiḇ·‘aṯ ham·miz·bə·ḥōṯ way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw ’eṯ- bam·miz·bê·aḥ wā·’a·‘al pār wā·’a·yil
verses.literal: and God met with him I have set up seven altars Balaam said - - and on each altar I have offered a bull and a ram

verses.original: יְהוָ֛ה וַיָּ֧שֶׂם דָּבָ֖ר בִלְעָ֑ם בְּפִ֣י וַיֹּ֛אמֶר שׁ֥וּב אֶל־ בָּלָ֖ק וְכֹ֥ה תְדַבֵּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yā·śem dā·ḇār ḇil·‘ām bə·p̄î way·yō·mer šūḇ ’el- bā·lāq wə·ḵōh ṯə·ḏab·bêr
verses.literal: Then the LORD put a message in Balaam’s mouth saying Return to Balak and give him this message

verses.original: וַיָּ֣שָׁב אֵלָ֔יו ה֖וּא נִצָּ֖ב וְהִנֵּ֥ה עַל־ עֹלָת֑וֹ וְכָל־ שָׂרֵ֥י מוֹאָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·šāḇ ’ê·lāw hū niṣ·ṣāḇ wə·hin·nêh ‘al- ‘ō·lā·ṯōw wə·ḵāl śā·rê mō·w·’āḇ
verses.literal: So he returned to Balak who was standing there beside his burnt offering with all the princes of Moab

verses.original: וַיִּשָּׂ֥א מְשָׁל֖וֹ וַיֹּאמַ֑ר בָלָ֤ק יַנְחֵ֨נִי מִן־ אֲ֠רָם מֶֽלֶךְ־ מוֹאָב֙ מֵֽהַרְרֵי־ קֶ֔דֶם לְכָה֙ אָֽרָה־ יַעֲקֹ֔ב לִּ֣י וּלְכָ֖ה זֹעֲמָ֥ה יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiś·śā mə·šā·lōw way·yō·mar ḇā·lāq yan·ḥê·nî min- ’ă·rām me·leḵ- mō·w·’āḇ mê·har·rê- qe·ḏem lə·ḵāh ’ā·rāh- ya·‘ă·qōḇ lî ū·lə·ḵāh zō·‘ă·māh yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: And Balaam lifted up an oracle saying Balak brought me from Aram the king of Moab from the mountains of the east Come,’ he said put a curse on Jacob for me come [and] denounce Israel

verses.original: מָ֣ה קַבֹּ֖ה אֵ֑ל לֹ֥א אֶקֹּ֔ב וּמָ֣ה אֶזְעֹ֔ם יְהוָֽה׃ לֹ֥א זָעַ֖ם
verses.transliteration: māh qab·bōh ’êl lō ’eq·qōḇ ū·māh ’ez·‘ōm Yah·weh lō zā·‘am
verses.literal: How can I curse [those whom] God has not cursed How can I denounce [those whom] the LORD has not denounced

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אֶרְאֶ֔נּוּ מֵרֹ֤אשׁ צֻרִים֙ אֲשׁוּרֶ֑נּוּ וּמִגְּבָע֖וֹת הֶן־ עָם֙ יִשְׁכֹּ֔ן לְבָדָ֣ד לֹ֥א יִתְחַשָּֽׁב׃ וּבַגּוֹיִ֖ם
verses.transliteration: kî- ’er·’en·nū mê·rōš ṣu·rîm ’ă·šū·ren·nū ū·mig·gə·ḇā·‘ō·wṯ hen- ‘ām yiš·kōn lə·ḇā·ḏāḏ lō yiṯ·ḥaš·šāḇ ū·ḇag·gō·w·yim
verses.literal: For I see them from atop the rocky cliffs and I watch them from the hills Behold a people dwelling apart not reckoning themselves among the nations

verses.original: מִ֤י מָנָה֙ עֲפַ֣ר יַעֲקֹ֔ב וּמִסְפָּ֖ר אֶת־ רֹ֣בַע יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל נַפְשִׁי֙ תָּמֹ֤ת מ֣וֹת יְשָׁרִ֔ים אַחֲרִיתִ֖י וּתְהִ֥י כָּמֹֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: mî mā·nāh ‘ă·p̄ar ya·‘ă·qōḇ ū·mis·pār ’eṯ- rō·ḇa‘ yiś·rā·’êl nap̄·šî tā·mōṯ mō·wṯ yə·šā·rîm ’a·ḥă·rî·ṯî ū·ṯə·hî kā·mō·hū
verses.literal: Who can count the dust of Jacob or number - [even] a fourth of Israel Let me die the death of the righteous let my end be like theirs

verses.original: בָּלָק֙ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֶל־ בִּלְעָ֔ם מֶ֥ה עָשִׂ֖יתָ לִ֑י לְקַחְתִּ֔יךָ לָקֹ֤ב אֹיְבַי֙ וְהִנֵּ֖ה בֵּרַ֥כְתָּ בָרֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: bā·lāq way·yō·mer ’el- bil·‘ām meh ‘ā·śî·ṯā lî lə·qaḥ·tî·ḵā lā·qōḇ ’ō·yə·ḇay wə·hin·nêh bê·raḵ·tā ḇā·rêḵ
verses.literal: Then Balak said to Balaam What have you done to me I brought you [here] to curse my enemies and behold you have only blessed them . . .

verses.original: וַיַּ֖עַן וַיֹּאמַ֑ר הֲלֹ֗א אֵת֩ לְדַבֵּֽר׃ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְהוָה֙ יָשִׂ֤ים בְּפִ֔י אֹת֥וֹ אֶשְׁמֹ֖ר
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an way·yō·mar hă·lō ’êṯ lə·ḏab·bêr ’ă·šer Yah·weh yā·śîm bə·p̄î ’ō·ṯōw ’eš·mōr
verses.literal: But [Balaam] replied . . . Should I not - speak exactly what the LORD puts in my mouth - -

verses.original: בָּלָ֗ק וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֜יו לְךָ נָּ֨א אִתִּ֜י אֶל־ אַחֵר֙ מָק֤וֹם אֲשֶׁ֣ר מִשָּׁ֔ם תִּרְאֶ֣נּוּ אֶ֚פֶס תִרְאֶ֔ה קָצֵ֣הוּ לֹ֣א תִרְאֶ֑ה וְכֻלּ֖וֹ מִשָּֽׁם׃ וְקָבְנוֹ־ לִ֖י
verses.transliteration: bā·lāq way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw lə·ḵå̄ ’it·tî ’el- ’a·ḥêr mā·qō·wm ’ă·šer miš·šām tir·’en·nū ’e·p̄es ṯir·’eh qā·ṣê·hū lō ṯir·’eh wə·ḵul·lōw miš·šām wə·qā·ḇə·nōw- lî
verses.literal: Then Balak said to him Please come . . . with me to another place where you can see them You will only see the outskirts of their camp not - all of them And from there curse them for me

verses.original: וַיִּקָּחֵ֙הוּ֙ שְׂדֵ֣ה צֹפִ֔ים אֶל־ רֹ֖אשׁ הַפִּסְגָּ֑ה וַיִּ֙בֶן֙ שִׁבְעָ֣ה מִזְבְּחֹ֔ת וַיַּ֛עַל פָּ֥ר וָאַ֖יִל בַּמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qā·ḥê·hū śə·ḏêh ṣō·p̄îm ’el- rōš hap·pis·gāh way·yi·ḇen šiḇ·‘āh miz·bə·ḥōṯ way·ya·‘al pār wā·’a·yil bam·miz·bê·aḥ
verses.literal: So Balak took him to the field of Zophim to the top of Pisgah where he built seven altars and offered a bull and a ram on each altar

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־ בָּלָ֔ק הִתְיַצֵּ֥ב כֹּ֖ה עַל־ עֹלָתֶ֑ךָ וְאָנֹכִ֖י אִקָּ֥רֶה כֹּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’el- bā·lāq hiṯ·yaṣ·ṣêḇ kōh ‘al- ‘ō·lā·ṯe·ḵā wə·’ā·nō·ḵî ’iq·qā·reh kōh
verses.literal: Balaam said to Balak Stay here beside your burnt offering while I meet [the LORD] over there

verses.original: יְהוָה֙ וַיִּקָּ֤ר אֶל־ בִּלְעָ֔ם וַיָּ֥שֶׂם דָּבָ֖ר בְּפִ֑יו וַיֹּ֛אמֶר שׁ֥וּב אֶל־ בָּלָ֖ק תְדַבֵּֽר׃ וְכֹ֥ה
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yiq·qār ’el- bil·‘ām way·yā·śem dā·ḇār bə·p̄îw way·yō·mer šūḇ ’el- bā·lāq ṯə·ḏab·bêr wə·ḵōh
verses.literal: And the LORD met with Balaam and put a message in his mouth saying Return to Balak and speak what I tell you

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֣א אֵלָ֗יו נִצָּב֙ וְהִנּ֤וֹ עַל־ עֹ֣לָת֔וֹ אִתּ֑וֹ וְשָׂרֵ֥י מוֹאָ֖ב מַה־ יְהוָֽה׃ דִּבֶּ֖ר בָּלָ֔ק וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לוֹ֙
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō ’ê·lāw niṣ·ṣāḇ wə·hin·nōw ‘al- ‘ō·lā·ṯōw ’it·tōw wə·śā·rê mō·w·’āḇ mah- Yah·weh dib·ber bā·lāq way·yō·mer lōw
verses.literal: So he returned to Balak who was standing there by his burnt offering with the princes of Moab What did the LORD say Balak asked

verses.original: וַיִּשָּׂ֥א מְשָׁל֖וֹ וַיֹּאמַ֑ר ק֤וּם בָּלָק֙ וּֽשֲׁמָ֔ע הַאֲזִ֥ינָה עָדַ֖י בְּנ֥וֹ צִפֹּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiś·śā mə·šā·lōw way·yō·mar qūm bā·lāq ū·šă·mā‘ ha·’ă·zî·nāh ‘ā·ḏay bə·nōw ṣip·pōr
verses.literal: Then Balaam lifted up an oracle saying Arise O Balak and listen give ear to me O son of Zippor

verses.original: אֵל֙ לֹ֣א אִ֥ישׁ וִֽיכַזֵּ֔ב וּבֶן־ אָדָ֖ם וְיִתְנֶחָ֑ם הַה֤וּא אָמַר֙ וְלֹ֣א יַעֲשֶׂ֔ה וְדִבֶּ֖ר וְלֹ֥א יְקִימֶֽנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: ’êl lō ’îš wî·ḵaz·zêḇ ū·ḇen- ’ā·ḏām wə·yiṯ·ne·ḥām ha·hū ’ā·mar wə·lō ya·‘ă·śeh wə·ḏib·ber wə·lō yə·qî·men·nāh
verses.literal: God is not a man that He should lie or a son of man that He should change His mind Does He speak and not act Does He promise and not fulfill

verses.original: הִנֵּ֥ה לָקָ֑חְתִּי בָרֵ֖ךְ וּבֵרֵ֖ךְ וְלֹ֥א אֲשִׁיבֶֽנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh lā·qā·ḥə·tî ḇā·rêḵ ū·ḇê·rêḵ wə·lō ’ă·šî·ḇen·nāh
verses.literal: I have indeed received a command to bless He has blessed and I cannot change it

verses.original: הִבִּ֥יט לֹֽא־ אָ֙וֶן֙ בְּיַעֲקֹ֔ב רָאָ֥ה וְלֹא־ עָמָ֖ל בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהָיו֙ עִמּ֔וֹ וּתְרוּעַ֥ת מֶ֖לֶךְ בּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hib·bîṭ lō- ’ā·wen bə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ rā·’āh wə·lō- ‘ā·māl bə·yiś·rā·’êl Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hāw ‘im·mōw ū·ṯə·rū·‘aṯ me·leḵ bōw
verses.literal: He considers no disaster for Jacob He sees no trouble for Israel The LORD their God is with them and the shout of the King is among them

verses.original: אֵ֖ל מוֹצִיאָ֣ם מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם כְּתוֹעֲפֹ֥ת רְאֵ֖ם לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’êl mō·w·ṣî·’ām mim·miṣ·rā·yim kə·ṯō·w·‘ă·p̄ōṯ rə·’êm lōw
verses.literal: God brought them out of Egypt with strength like a wild ox

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹא־ נַ֙חַשׁ֙ בְּיַעֲקֹ֔ב וְלֹא־ קֶ֖סֶם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כָּעֵ֗ת יֵאָמֵ֤ר לְיַעֲקֹב֙ וּלְיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מַה־ אֵֽל׃ פָּ֖עַל
verses.transliteration: kî lō- na·ḥaš bə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ wə·lō- qe·sem bə·yiś·rā·’êl kā·‘êṯ yê·’ā·mêr lə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ ū·lə·yiś·rā·’êl mah- ’êl pā·‘al
verses.literal: For there is no spell against Jacob and no divination against Israel It will now be said of Jacob and Israel What great things God has done

verses.original: הֶן־ עָם֙ יָק֔וּם כְּלָבִ֣יא יִתְנַשָּׂ֑א וְכַאֲרִ֖י לֹ֤א יִשְׁכַּב֙ עַד־ יֹ֣אכַל טֶ֔רֶף יִשְׁתֶּֽה׃ וְדַם־ חֲלָלִ֖ים
verses.transliteration: hen- ‘ām yā·qūm kə·lā·ḇî yiṯ·naś·śā wə·ḵa·’ă·rî lō yiš·kaḇ ‘aḏ- yō·ḵal ṭe·rep̄ yiš·teh wə·ḏam- ḥă·lā·lîm
verses.literal: Behold the people rise like a lioness they rouse themselves like a lion not resting until they devour their prey and drink the blood of the slain

verses.original: בָּלָק֙ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֶל־ בִּלְעָ֔ם גַּם־ לֹ֣א תִקֳּבֶ֑נּוּ קֹ֖ב גַּם־ לֹ֥א בָּרֵ֖ךְ תְבָרֲכֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: bā·lāq way·yō·mer ’el- bil·‘ām gam- lō ṯiq·qo·ḇen·nū qōḇ gam- lō bā·rêḵ ṯə·ḇā·ră·ḵen·nū
verses.literal: Now Balak said to Balaam Then neither curse them at all . . . nor bless them at all

verses.original: בִּלְעָ֔ם וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אֶל־ וַיַּ֣עַן בָּלָ֑ק הֲלֹ֗א דִּבַּ֤רְתִּי אֵלֶ֙יךָ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֹת֥וֹ יְדַבֵּ֥ר אֶֽעֱשֶֽׂה׃
verses.transliteration: bil·‘ām way·yō·mer ’el- way·ya·‘an bā·lāq hă·lō dib·bar·tî ’ê·le·ḵā lê·mōr kōl ’ă·šer- Yah·weh ’ō·ṯōw yə·ḏab·bêr ’e·‘ĕ·śeh
verses.literal: But Balaam . . . . . . replied - Did I not tell you that . . . . . . whatever - the LORD - says I must do

verses.original: נָּא֙ לְכָה־ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר בָּלָק֙ אֶל־ בִּלְעָ֔ם אֶקָּ֣חֲךָ֔ אֶל־ אַחֵ֑ר מָק֖וֹם אוּלַ֤י יִישַׁר֙ בְּעֵינֵ֣י הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים וְקַבֹּ֥תוֹ לִ֖י מִשָּֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: nā lə·ḵāh- way·yō·mer bā·lāq ’el- bil·‘ām ’eq·qā·ḥă·ḵā ’el- ’a·ḥêr mā·qō·wm ’ū·lay yî·šar bə·‘ê·nê hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·qab·bō·ṯōw lî miš·šām
verses.literal: Please come said Balak - - I will take you to another place Perhaps it will please . . . God that you curse them for me from there

verses.original: בָּלָ֖ק אֶת־ וַיִּקַּ֥ח בִּלְעָ֑ם רֹ֣אשׁ הַפְּע֔וֹר הַנִּשְׁקָ֖ף עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י הַיְשִׁימֹֽן׃
verses.transliteration: bā·lāq ’eṯ- way·yiq·qaḥ bil·‘ām rōš hap·pə·‘ō·wr han·niš·qāp̄ ‘al- pə·nê hay·šî·mōn
verses.literal: And Balak - took Balaam to the top of Peor which overlooks . . . . . . the wasteland

verses.original: בִּלְעָם֙ אֶל־ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר בָּלָ֔ק בְּנֵה־ לִ֥י שִׁבְעָ֣ה מִזְבְּחֹ֑ת בָזֶ֖ה וְהָכֵ֥ן לִי֙ בָּזֶ֔ה שִׁבְעָ֥ה פָרִ֖ים וְשִׁבְעָ֥ה אֵילִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: bil·‘ām ’el- way·yō·mer bā·lāq bə·nêh- lî šiḇ·‘āh miz·bə·ḥōṯ ḇā·zeh wə·hā·ḵên lî bā·zeh šiḇ·‘āh p̄ā·rîm wə·šiḇ·‘āh ’ê·lîm
verses.literal: Then Balaam . . . said - Build for me seven altars here and prepare for me . . . seven bulls and seven rams

verses.original: בָּלָ֔ק וַיַּ֣עַשׂ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר בִּלְעָ֑ם אָמַ֣ר וַיַּ֛עַל פָּ֥ר וָאַ֖יִל בַּמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: bā·lāq way·ya·‘aś ka·’ă·šer bil·‘ām ’ā·mar way·ya·‘al pār wā·’a·yil bam·miz·bê·aḥ
verses.literal: So Balak did as Balaam had instructed and he offered a bull and a ram on each altar
